thread:
Noah: EdgeCompute (customer_id: edge-900) disputed INV-20260701. They were charged $3,950 in burst/overage on top of their 8-GPU reserved commit. They say no traffic spike. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/INV-20260701.pdf — can billing investigate?

Imani: grabbing usage export now: s3://billing-exports/edge-900/2026-07.csv. BILL-3357 opened.

meter-bot: Export ready edge-900/2026-07.csv. Summary: total tokens 880M, burst tokens 31M, burst charges $3,950.

Raj: CS received a support note: "We saw steady requests but suddenly higher cost per-token". They attached app logs showing same request patterns. Support #4801.

Noah: Running a quick join to usage + model_catalog to check model_variant and quantization flags:
```sql
SELECT ts, request_id, model, variant, quantized, tokens
FROM dedicated_usage
WHERE customer_id='edge-900' AND date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-02'
ORDER BY ts;
```
Found that around 2026-07-01T11:04 UTC many requests switched from model_variant="gptx-q4" (quantized) to "gptx-fp16" (non-quantized) and billed at higher rate.

Imani: Did the customer change model alias? That could trigger a fallback to full-precision.

Raj: Customer says they didn't change alias. They do deploy a canary that should be pinned to q4.

Noah: Also noticed an internal pricing experiment flag on our side: experiment_id=price-tier-2026-q3 rolled to 5% of requests and matched by seed. A subset of EdgeCompute's traffic (seeded) got routed to non-quantized model for AB testing. That would explain higher unit rate.

ops-bot: Experiment audit: price-tier-2026-q3 matched edge-900 for approx 28k requests between 11:00-11:30 UTC. INF-7935 created to check rollout targeting.

Imani: Action items: 1) Mark experiment-tagged requests as nonbillable (internal experiment) or apply credit for the on-demand differential. 2) Produce corrected usage CSV and credit proposal.

Noah: Quick math: affected tokens = 12.4M. Per-token differential between fp16 and q4 = $0.00018/token -> differential ~= $2,232. Add a goodwill credit of $1,500 for the surprise and procurement friction -> total proposed credit $3,732 (round to $3,750).

Imani: Recommend provisional credit $3,750 to INV-20260701 while INF-7935 verifies experiment targeting and we update experiment exclusion lists. Approvers: @Imani (Finance), @Noah (Billing).

Noah: I approve. Applying provisional credit now and annotating invoice: "Provisional credit for internal pricing experiment impact - under review". BILL-3357 updated.

ops-bot: BILL-3357 updated: provisional credit $3,750 applied. Linked support #4801, INF-7935, PM-1058.

Raj: Messaged customer: "We've applied a provisional credit of $3,750 while we reconcile an internal experiment that affected some requests. We'll follow up within 48 hours with final breakdown." They replied: "Thanks, please confirm final numbers asap."

Noah: INF confirmed experiment incorrectly targeted a segment that included edge-900; rollout config lacked partner exclusion. INF-7935 root cause = missing exclusion rule. Corrected export posted s3://billing-exports/edge-900/corrections/2026-07-experiment-attrib.csv. Affected tokens validated = 12.4M, differential = $2,232.

Imani: Final decision: keep provisional credit $3,750 (covers differential + goodwill). Approving final credit and closing BILL-3357.

meter-bot: BILL-3357 closed. Final credit applied: $3,750 to INV-20260701. Notification sent to edge-900.

Raj: Customer acknowledged and resumed payment. PM-1058 to add experiment exclusion for reserved-commit customers to prevent recurrence.

Imani: Closing thread. Thanks team."
